fx_fee.notes: No Foreign Transaction Fees — 'Marriott Bonvoy Card Members enjoy international travel without foreign transaction fees from American Express when using their Card on purchases abroad.'

base_rate.description: 2X Marriott Bonvoy points on other purchases made using the Marriott Bonvoy Business American Express Card.

categories.label: Restaurants Worldwide, U.S. Gas Stations, Wireless Telephone Services, U.S. Shipping

rewards.redemption_notes: Marriott Bonvoy points can be redeemed for free nights at participating hotels, and through Air+Car for flights and car rentals.

benefits.title: Marriott Bonvoy Room Rate Discount
benefits.description: Receive a 7% discount on eligible bookings at hotels which participate in the Marriott Bonvoy program when you book directly through an eligible Marriott channel under the Amex Business Card Rate.

benefits.title: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Enjoy complimentary Gold Elite status with your Marriott Bonvoy Business American Express Card. Includes priority late checkout (until 2 p.m., subject to availability) and earn 25% more points on every eligible hotel purchase. Must book with a Qualifying Rate at participating hotels.

benefits.title: Earn & Redeem Free Nights
benefits.description: Receive 1 Free Night Award every year after your Card renewal month. Plus, earn an additional Free Night Award after you spend $60K in purchases on your Card in a calendar year. Awards can be used for one night (redemption level at or under 35,000 Marriott Bonvoy points) at participating hotels. Certain hotels have resort fees.

benefits.title: Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: Each calendar year, receive 15 Elite Night Credits towards the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status. Limitations apply per Marriott Bonvoy member account.

benefits.title: Air+Car Transfer Program
benefits.description: Air+Car allows members to redeem Marriott Bonvoy points for flights and car rentals across hundreds of travel partners around the world.

benefits.title: Premium on-property Internet Access
benefits.description: Receive free in-room, premium Internet access while staying at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels. Booking requirements apply.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: Marriott Bonvoy Card Members enjoy international travel without foreign transaction fees from American Express when using their Card on purchases abroad.

other: Free Night Award annually + additional after $60K spend
